name: Disharmony of Flame
summary: Thunderheart sends you to the quarry in Blackrock Mountain to slay Overmaster Pyron. Return to Thunderheart when the assignment is complete.

sections.title: At the Quarry
sections.body: The quarry in Blackrock Mountain is where Thunderheart sends you. Overmaster Pyron is your target, and Thunderheart awaits your return after the assignment is complete.

faq.q: Who is Thunderheart asking me to kill?
faq.answer: Thunderheart sends you to slay Overmaster Pyron at the quarry in Blackrock Mountain.
Overmaster Pyron is at the quarry in Blackrock Mountain.

faq.q: Who do I return to afterward?
faq.answer: Return to Thunderheart when you have completed the assignment.

attribution: In-game quest text: Disharmony of Flame
